name: Ducati 916 / 996 / 998
engine: 748-998 cc liquid-cooled 90-degree L-twin, desmo 4-valve, fuel injected
intro: Tamburini's superbike. Belt-driven desmo four-valve heads, a single-sided swingarm and a dry clutch.

add.title: Check the timing belts and desmo valve clearances
add.instructions: Replace the cam timing belts on schedule, by age as well as miles, and check the desmo opening and closing clearances. Old belts can snap and wreck the engine.
add.reason: Ducati belt-drive twins need belts changed on time even if the bike sat.

E: Chain slack is set with the eccentric hub in the single-sided swingarm.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
